findings.evidence: "The endpoint_url field accepts an HTTPS URL that receives the webhook payload for each triggered alert."
findings.fix: Add a line stating whether endpoint_url is required, and if optional, what the default/behavior is when unset.
findings.violation: Unlike retry_policy, this entry states no default value and never says whether the field is required; a reference doc should specify this for every field.

findings.evidence: "The signing_secret field accepts a string used to verify the payload signature on receipt."
findings.fix: Document the signature scheme (algorithm, header name, encoding) and any constraints on the secret string.
findings.violation: The doc never explains the signing algorithm (e.g., HMAC-SHA256), which header carries the signature, or any constraints on the secret (length, allowed characters), making it impossible to actually implement verification from this reference.

findings.evidence: "The retry_policy field accepts one of none, linear, or exponential, and the default value is exponential."
findings.fix: Add a definition for each retry_policy value (e.g., number of attempts, delay schedule) or link to the section that defines it.
findings.violation: The three enum values are named but never defined - there's no description of retry counts, intervals, backoff multipliers, or max duration for linear vs exponential, so readers can't predict delivery behavior.

findings.evidence: Only three fields (endpoint_url, signing_secret, retry_policy) are documented under "Webhook delivery reference"
findings.fix: Either add sections for timeout, payload schema, and headers, or scope the title/intro to clarify this document only covers configuration fields, not full delivery behavior.
findings.violation: A delivery reference omits other fields typically needed to understand delivery behavior, such as timeout duration, payload/event schema, and which HTTP headers are sent - leaving the reference incomplete for its stated scope.
